product_one_liner.value: SMS-Magic is a CRM-integrated multichannel business messaging platform for sales and marketing representatives and service agents, enabling conversations through SMS, WhatsApp, MMS, Facebook Messenger, and LINE.
product_one_liner.notes: The public Salesforce documentation describes multichannel business messaging and names sales/marketing representatives and service agents as target users, including WhatsApp, SMS, MMS, Facebook, and LINE.

pricing_page.notes: The public SMS-Magic pricing page is titled 'Simple, transparent pricing' and provides plan and pricing-related information.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The official customer case-studies page identifies Upstart and Renault as companies using SMS-Magic in named case studies. | named_customers.0: The official case-studies index names Upstart and links to its Upstart case study. | named_customers.1: The official case-studies index names Renault and links to its Renault case study.

employee_band.notes: Built In reports 208 total employees, and SMS-Magic's careers page says it has 200+ team members in India, supporting the 201-500 band. LinkedIn gives a broader 51-200 range, so the evidence is not perfectly consistent.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The current LinkedIn profile identifies Henderson, Nevada as headquarters and the official contact page labels the Henderson address the Global/USA Headquarters; an older careers-page line says Pune, so this selection is made with a caveat. | hq_country: The current LinkedIn profile lists Henderson, Nevada as headquarters, and the official contact page labels its Henderson address the Global/USA Headquarters. An older careers-page statement says Pune is still headquarters, so I use the more current listing and official location designation, with some uncertainty.

founded_year.notes: SMS-Magic's LinkedIn company profile identifies the company as founded in 2008.

eng_blog.notes: The official blog index shows consumer and marketing topics such as messaging tips, Salesforce use, and compliance; its current index entries do not show posts about engineering or how the product is built. No separate technical engineering blog was found.

public_docs.notes: The official Technical Resource Center links multiple product guides, Salesforce and Zoho documentation, portal guides, messaging guides, release notes, and a developer guide.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers page lists open roles, including Growth Manager, Cloud Infrastructure Team Lead, and Sales roles, but no title containing AI, ML, data science, or the other specified AI/ML role terms.

model_provider.value: OpenAI (an optional integration in which customers connect their own existing models; no default provider is disclosed).
model_provider.notes: Product documentation explicitly offers an OpenAI integration, but describes users connecting their own existing models; it does not identify a default model provider for the product itself.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company's trust compliance page lists ISO 27001:2013 under security certificates and standards, and HIPAA and GDPR under industry-based compliance. | compliance_certs.0: The trust page names ISO 27001:2013 under security certificates and standards. | compliance_certs.1: The trust page names HIPAA under industry-based compliance. | compliance_certs.2: The trust page names GDPR under industry-based compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The only reported financing is the co-founder's friends-and-family money for the initial prototype; Tracxn reports no formal funding rounds. The available account does not give a month for that early financing. | funding_amount_usd: A profile of SMS-Magic co-founder and CEO Nitin Seth reports that he raised the equivalent of US $5,000 from friends and family to develop the company's first prototype. This is the only specific outside-financing amount found; Tracxn records no formal funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: The only specifically described outside capital was friends-and-family financing to get the business's first prototype off the ground; the company was founded in 2008, and Tracxn reports no later formal funding rounds. This supports no fundraising in the 18-month period before November 9, 2026, though the original contribution's month is not stated.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers page lists both Team Lead – Account Executive and SDR – Team Lead openings.

launched_6mo.notes: The SMS-Magic changelog labels a release dated October 26, 2026 and describes new consent-management capabilities, including form-based consent capture, inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The dated announcement found is Vikas Narang's appointment as COO on October 1, 2025, before the 12-month window beginning November 9, 2025. The visible organization chart lists current CEO, CTO, COO, and VP of Product leadership; no C-level or VP join/leave inside the window was identified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: SMS-Magic's trust subprocessor table names Salesforce, Pardot, MailChimp, and Zapier for CRM, marketing, email, or automation uses; its product documentation separately provides a Zoho guide. | crm_stack_signal.0: The subprocessor table names Salesforce and identifies it as used for Customer Relationship Management. | crm_stack_signal.1: The official technical documentation has a dedicated Zoho guide and Zoho release-note category. | crm_stack_signal.2: The subprocessor table names Pardot for marketing data management. | crm_stack_signal.3: The subprocessor table names MailChimp for sending application emails. | crm_stack_signal.4: The subprocessor table names Zapier for marketing automation.
